owner: Biotech team (Ana & Fidel). Software reads this file; it never hard-codes thresholds.
status: Prototype operating thresholds. Each cut-off cites its source; cut-offs marked 'operational' are design decisions of the prototype based on those sources. Galley is decision support, NOT a medical device.
color_logic: 1. Personal baseline deviation (robust z-score) decides GREEN / YELLOW / RED.
2. Absolute safety limits always win (RED/YELLOW regardless of baseline).
3. Combination rules and CUSUM trends (data/reference/rules.json) can raise the escalation level.

baseline.method: Start: registered 'usual' value as center + sigma_floor as scale. With >= 5 eligible days: median and MAD of the last 14 days, EXCLUDING the 3 most recent days (so an evolving problem does not contaminate its own baseline). scale = max(1.4826 * MAD, sigma_floor); robust_z = (x - median) / scale.
